settings.labs.flag.runState.label: Run state
settings.labs.flag.runState.description: Marks results as stale once you edit after the last run: an amber border around the editor, dimmed inline values with their age and a STALE pill in the Dock. Settings › Editor gets a run policy per language group: On keystroke, On pause or Manual.
settings.labs.flag.paletteAutodetect.des: The Command Palette tells a question, a file name and a command apart. On a code tab, a question goes to Explain this code, which can include the last run (Pro), a file name opens Quick Open with it typed in, and anything else searches commands. Start with ! to search commands only.
settings.labs.flag.teachingPaywall.label: Pro in context
settings.labs.flag.teachingPaywall.descr: A PRO chip on a limited feature opens one Compare plans table, the license pill in the command bar shows a trial's days left or offers one, only the first upgrade notice in a session offers Compare plans, and on Free recent runs, utility pipelines and run capsules open a slice instead of a lock.
settings.labs.flag.instantSql.label: Instant SQL
settings.labs.flag.instantSql.descriptio: In the SQL workspace on Local, a sampled preview of the statement under the cursor refreshes as you type, above the results. With the cursor in a CTE it shows that CTE and marks what reads it. Writes, remote reads and functions with side effects never run on their own, and connections never preview. A computed column's header breaks it down by NULLs.
settings.labs.flag.ejectToCode.label: GUI actions to code
settings.labs.flag.ejectToCode.descripti: An HTTP request can open as a JavaScript tab that runs in the Worker, with its secrets and credentials left as placeholders, and the SQL a grid's filters, sort and columns generate can be saved as a snippet, and a utility pipeline as a JavaScript snippet.
settings.labs.flag.clipboardChains.label: Clipboard-aware utilities
settings.labs.flag.clipboardChains.descr: With Apply from clipboard on panel focus on in Settings › Editor › Developer Utilities, Utilities classifies the clipboard on this device when it opens and on window focus, and marks the tools that fit. Needs Pro. Without that setting or any clipboard read, outputs can go to a pipeline step, and pipeline steps can be disabled, paused with a breakpoint or re-run with auto-bake, on Pro or on Free with Pro in context.
settings.labs.flag.dbClient.label: Database connections
settings.labs.flag.dbClient.description: Connect the SQL tab to Postgres, MySQL, SQL Server and ClickHouse servers and to SQLite files. Desktop only; Local DuckDB stays the default.
settings.labs.flag.editRows.label: Edit table rows
settings.labs.flag.editRows.description: Edit cells, add, duplicate and delete rows of a table opened from the SQL Explorer, review the SQL, and commit it in one transaction. Never on read-only or production connections, nor on ClickHouse.
